generation_budget.freeze_rule: Freeze the smallest tested budget with zero length truncations on all pre-gate stress probes; refuse the stability gate if no candidate fits every frozen prompt with the answer reserve and safety margin.

determinism_policy.d11_disambiguation: D11 is the local-first ablation subset and is unrelated to API determinism controls.
determinism_policy.divergence_unit: one frozen prompt compared across three repetitions
determinism_policy.divergence_event: Any difference in abstain, predicted_label, parsed JSON, finish reason, parse validity, or raw response bytes across the three first attempts. Reasoning text differences are raw-response differences.

pilot_sample.origin: future frozen Study 2 development artifacts, produced after the scientific prerequisites are completed; final-test, OOD and ground-truth evaluation artifacts are forbidden

per_agent_design.transfer_triplet: A, B-LF and E-LF for one frozen locally-unseen development case
per_agent_design.context_stress_pair: B-LF and E-LF for the longest other eligible development prompt after offline tokenization

pilot_sample.representation: Balances all eight recipients, covers every in-catalog fault once in the matched transfer triplets, exercises all three conditions, and deliberately over-samples 14-insight prompts for context stress.
pilot_sample.limitations: Technical gate sample, not a random or population-representative sample. It does not estimate diagnostic accuracy, broad abstention behavior, local-seen or Normal performance, OOD behavior, or final-test behavior.
